system.description:
Only characters with the Mage Archetype Class can use this item.

At the start of a scene, you gain [Cancel (Flame, Cold, Shock): 10]. Treat your acquired Twilight Mantle skill as if it had +1 SR (the Max SR may be exceeded). If you do not have the skill acquired, you acquire it with SR1.

  • Dark Spider Silk [Core Material] (50G)
  • Mantle (60G) × 3
  • [Magic Catalyst 3] (25G) × 2
  • Crafting Cost (120G)
